title: bromus lepidus var. micromollis
intro: Bromus lepidus var. micromollis, commonly known as Mountain Brome, is a perennial grass species native to North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Brome include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Bromus lepidus var. micromollis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
